HIGH COMPATIBILITY: Perfect for COSORI Air Fryer with a capacity above 5.0 QT such as CAF-L501/CP358-AF/CAF-P583S/CS358-AF. Can be used with most air fryer brands like Ninja, PowerXL, Instant Pot, as well with COSORI air fryer ovens like AF1001/CAF-R121-SUS.
EASY TO CLEAN AND DISHWASHER SAFE: The nonstick coating makes cleaning a breeze. Conveniently clean the accessories in the dishwasher without damaging them
BPA FREE: Made of healthy and safe food grade and heat-resisting materials, our accessories are BPA free, no worry about any hazardous chemicals, enjoy funny and healthy cooking

COOKING POSSIBILITIES: These air fryer accessories are perfect for getting even more flavor out of dishes like French fries, onion rings, chicken strips, roast vegetables, pizzas, cookies, biscuits, fish, mozzarella sticks, pork, corn dogs, prawns, and broccoli
A WARM REMINDER: Please select your accessories after thoroughly reading the size description to best match your air fryer
